caption: The drawing contains four rectangular fabric swatches arranged in a two-by-two grid, with one swatch centered at the top and three swatches aligned below it. The top swatch features a plaid design with intersecting brown, cream, and turquoise blue lines forming a grid with solid color blocks. The bottom left swatch displays a repeated pattern of small, red and light pink star-shaped flowers with blue centers on a dark burgundy background. The bottom right swatch has a checkered design with blue and cream squares, some of which contain red and yellow stylized floral motifs. The swatch at the bottom center presents a grid pattern made up of blue lines on a burgundy background, with yellow-green leaves inside several of the squares. All four swatches are set against a plain, off-white background. The name "ALBERT LEVONE" is written in small, uppercase letters below the bottom center swatch.
title: Cotton Prints
